544:t_2:421.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I told you not to move.」

544:t_2:424.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's your fault! I told you... I told you so many times not to come!」

544:t_2:425.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You killed her! How are you going to make up for that!?」

544:t_2:427.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$...! This is just a temporary mental disturbance! That's why I'll...」

544:t_2:433.en:
$$宗介$$
(Why did it have to end like this... $$千鳥$$...)

544:t_2:437.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Don't worry... I will be waiting for you.)

544:t_2:441.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$! Get a hold of yourself, $$宗介$$!!」

544:t_2:444.en:
$n
「I saw $$千鳥$$ run away from here. Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ is unconscious, but she's unharmed.」

544:t_2:445.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's impossible...! I saw $$テッサ$$ get shot dead...!」

544:t_2:446.en:
$$宗介$$
「And why am I still alive!?」

544:t_2:448.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you saying... that was one possible outcome $$千鳥$$ showed me...?」

544:t_2:449.en:
$n
「We have to get out of here. The $$クロノ$$ Reformists are about to destroy this facility.」

544:t_2:451.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... Your voice... Your feelings... that reached me in the darkness of death...)

544:t_2:452.en:
$$宗介$$
(If you're waiting for me, I will come for you...!)

544:t_3:3.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...I believe I understand what I did...)

544:t_3:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I killed $$宗介$$, and I killed $$テッサ$$...)

544:t_3:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Those poor two... Their deaths are painful and sad, but I have no more use for them...)

544:t_3:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
(We're done pretending to be friends or star-crossed lovers.)

544:t_3:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
(This world will be remade in the not-too-distant future anyway...)

544:t_3:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I don't need to care what happens or who dies... As long as I survive...)

544:t_3:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I have a mission $$ソフィア$$ entrusted to me... I am the only person who can save this world...)

544:t_3:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That man must have foreseen this and brought me to $$ヤムスク１１$$... I'm sure he's prepared for what we must do next...)

544:t_3:11.en:
$$レナード$$
「It seems you've finally awakened.」

544:t_3:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes. I'm sorry I kept you waiting.」

544:t_3:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's almost ready. I've been working on it since we took $$メリダ島$$.」

544:t_3:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll go anywhere you wish, my princess.」

544:t_3:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're so kind. You won't be rough with me anymore?」

544:t_3:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「There is no longer any need. Isn't that right?」

544:t_3:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes... I won't make any more selfish demands.」

544:t_10:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Is there some curse that makes nice-guy snipers who draw the short straw die young...?」

544:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Even while worrying about $$クルツ$$, your resolve made $$尸空#pilot$$ falter and produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s...」

544:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I will add these to the team's stock.」

544:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I feel as though a great hole has opened in my heart too...」

544:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open today, but we will postpone celebrating our ace pilots until next time.」

544:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$クルツ$$... I will never forget... our dirty jokes.」

544:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Allow me to say this in tribute to his soul. As always... Business, business.」

544:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A kindhearted sniper has died... Am I to feel... that sorrow again...?」

545:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All units are in position.」

545:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now the $$アマルガム$$ forces in the area should take our bait.」

545:t_000:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Meanwhile, Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ and the others will sneak into that place called $$ヤムスク１１$$.」

545:t_000:3.en:
$$桂$$
「So what exactly is in those ruins?」

545:t_000:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$テッサ$$... Isn't it about time you explained it to us too?」

545:t_000:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「Exactly. One commander who works us to the bone without explaining anything is enough.」

545:t_000:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「She's holding quite a grudge, $$ゼロ$$.」

545:t_000:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I'm used to that sort of thing.」

545:t_000:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...$$ヤムスク１１$$, where we are heading, is a research city built by the $$人革連$$.」

545:t_000:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「More than ten years before the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$'s 《$$プロメテウス・エクスペリメント$$》...」

545:t_000:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They conducted the first experiments in $$ＡＤＷ$$ history to artificially produce a $$時空震動$$.」

545:t_000:16.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$アマルガム$$ is trying to develop $$時空震動弾$$s...」

545:t_000:17.en:
$$スザク$$
「So there may be clues to their activities there...」

545:t_000:18.en:
$$テッサ$$
(And the secrets of $$カナメ$$ and the rest of us lie dormant there too...)

545:t_000:19.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Everyone here will serve as a diversion to draw $$アマルガム$$ in.」

545:t_000:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I don't intend to stop at just being a decoy.」

545:t_000:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「After all, I'm in top form right now! I'm not afraid of anything!」

545:t_000:23.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ウェーバー$$... Don't forget why I authorized you to operate alone.」

545:t_000:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I understand! Master Sergeant $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$ will make the plan he devised succeed, without fail!」
